show_identity.podcast_description: {ATTORNEY_NAME} has spent 30 years in Maryland courtrooms. Each week he sits down to explain what Maryland law really says, and what it really does, when a marriage falls apart, a parent wants to move with the kids, CPS shows up at the door, or a custody fight turns criminal. The show is for {PRIMARY_COUNTY} and {SECONDARY_COUNTY} County families who want straight talk from a trial lawyer instead of another generic legal blog. Maryland statutes, Maryland case law (including {FIRST_NAME}'s own Braun v. Headley), and the practical decisions families face once the paperwork starts.
show_identity.tagline: Plain Maryland law from the attorney who took a custody case to the doorstep of the U.S. Supreme Court.
target_audience: Spouses considering or going through a divorce in {PRIMARY_COUNTY} and {SECONDARY_COUNTY} counties.
Maryland parents facing a CPS investigation, a CINA petition, or a false-allegation custody fight.
Military and first-responder families at Fort Meade, NSA, U.S. Coast Guard, and Maryland State Police dealing with deployment custody and federal-benefit divisions in a divorce.
